scope: Public, simulation-only development. Neither real-data paper qualification nor physical safety is assessed.

architecture_exclusion.lqr_primary_mpc_takeover: No independently justified available-information trigger distinguishes it from a tuned performance oracle. Keep excluded before outcomes.

architecture_semantics: Legacy lqr and mpc are PP feedforward plus bounded LQR or MPC correction. Pure shadows compute on the same observation and receive the applied action for bypass-state synchronization, but never control the plant. The blend applies PP once plus weighted bounded corrections. A bypassed MPC warm start is reset, not treated as a prediction from the active trajectory.

simulation.finish: Gym checkpoint_done, which may require two circuits; report geometric first crossing separately

mpc_timeout.fault: Reject every twentieth MPC result, starting with call 20, after its computation; 20 ms injected completion delay

scheduler: At each 10 ms control tick, invoke only when no prior computation is pending. A result becomes eligible at the first following tick at or after measured whole-wrapper compute time plus declared injected delay and actuation delay. Hold the previous applied command meanwhile. A late result cannot affect earlier steps. Deadline miss means total whole-wrapper compute exceeds 10 ms. Ideal mode applies the bounded new command on the call tick, except declared actuation delay. All shadow work is included in timed duration.

fallback.trigger: MPC failure, nonfinite or out-of-domain proposal, or measured primary solve time over 10 ms; injected fault has the same failure path
fallback.transfer: rate-limit the newly selected command against the last applied command
fallback.missing_shadow: ignore for pure shadow; reject for blend

tuning.selection: on existing +0.25 m development tuning start, completion then common motion-constraint pass then minimum RMS reference distance; ties use registered candidate order

ranking.completion: descending completed scenario count; missing run is not silently dropped
ranking.feasibility: all registered scenarios complete, no collision, no shared motion-limit violations, and no measured 10 ms compute deadline miss in deadline-aware runs
ranking.overall: qualifying candidates first; then fewer noncompletions, fewer motion-limit failures, fewer deadline misses, lower worst eligible Gym finish, lower mean RMS reference distance, then architecture order
ranking.noncompletion: null finish time; no imputed penalty
ranking.repeatability: deterministic same-seed replay checked; repeated runs are not independent samples

comparison: Same map, qualified line, start, seed and vehicle-parameter pair for each architecture. Exposed prior scenarios are regression controls. No reserved group or real archive access.
pilot: Run one short example-track ideal PP and PP+LQR/MPC shadow pair before the full matrix. Save every run by deterministic run ID and skip only when its protocol hash and telemetry hash verify.
